tolerance.pattern: ^shellAcceptsOwnFaces / shellRejectsPartiallyForeignFaceList \[own, foreign\] -> \[own\]: upward=1 done=1 valid=1 volume=[-0-9.eE+]+$
tolerance.reason: the same kernel non-determinism as the line below, in the same BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid family. Thirty runs of one binary against the pinned v4.0.0-kernel.3 asset printed 4519.4099853010057 seventeen times, ...66 twelve times and ...48 once, a relative spread of 4.0e-16. It drifts less often than its neighbour, which is why #2965 reported only one line of this probe: a whole-population run caught it on the third try. `upward=1 done=1 valid=1` and every word of the label stay compared exactly. The cause is #3003 and it is found: BRepOffset_MakeOffset::BuildOffsetByArc hands the roots of its image to the shell builder in the iteration order of a DataMap hashed on TShape addresses, so the faces of the result, and the order the volume is summed in, change between processes. Kernel patch 0053 fixes it and the pinned asset does not carry it yet, so this declaration stays until the repin that pins it, and comes out then with the transcript recaptured (patched value 4519.4099853010057, which is the value the transcript already holds). Scripts/repro/3003-offset-roots-hash-order/. #2965.

tolerance.pattern: ^shellRejectsPartiallyForeignFaceList \[foreign\] -> no open face: done=1 valid=1 volume=[-0-9.eE+]+$
tolerance.reason: the line #2965 measured. Thirty runs of one binary against the pinned asset printed four distinct values, -13587.492558290327 to ...32, a relative spread of 3.7e-16, a couple of units in the last place of a double; the transcript's ...29 is one of them. Declared as a tolerance rather than volatile because the volume IS the measurement: `done=1 valid=1` and every word of the label stay compared exactly, and the run prints the worst difference it saw. The cause is #3003 and it is found: BRepOffset_MakeOffset::BuildOffsetByArc hands the roots of its image to the shell builder in the iteration order of a DataMap hashed on TShape addresses, so the faces of the result, and the order the volume is summed in, change between processes. Kernel patch 0053 fixes it and the pinned asset does not carry it yet, so this declaration stays until the repin that pins it, and comes out then with the transcript recaptured (patched value -13587.492558290332, against the transcript's ...329). Scripts/repro/3003-offset-roots-hash-order/. #2965.
